articles.title: What MCPEmails does
articles.summary: It connects your mailboxes to AI assistants like Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor through one URL.
articles.keywords: what is mcp emails mcpemails about overview how it works mcp server ai assistant agent stored privacy
body: Mail is fetched live for each request and not stored. Only your encrypted mailbox password or access token is kept.

articles.title: Get set up
articles.summary: Connect a mailbox, then add the MCP server URL to your AI assistant.
articles.keywords: get started setup first steps sign up create account onboarding quick start begin new
steps: In Overview, choose Connect inbox on the Get started card.
Copy the MCP server URL from the same card.
Under Choose your client, pick your assistant and follow its steps.
Ask your assistant: Summarize my unread email from today.

articles.title: Pick how to connect your mailbox
articles.summary: Outlook signs in with Microsoft, Gmail and a few others use an app password, the rest use IMAP.
articles.keywords: connect inbox mailbox provider choose option app password imap smtp outlook gmail icloud yahoo zoho yandex fastmail which method limit
steps: Outlook.com or Microsoft 365: choose Outlook and sign in with Microsoft.
Gmail, iCloud, Yahoo, Zoho, Yandex or Fastmail: choose its card and paste an app password.
Any other mailbox or your own domain: choose IMAP / SMTP.
body: Free connects one mailbox, Personal three and Pro up to 10. Business includes 10 and can add more.

articles.title: Connect Gmail
articles.summary: Paste a Google app password, or sign in with Google instead.
articles.keywords: gmail google connect app password 2-step verification google sign-in oauth unverified app warning advanced unsafe two factor 2fa two-step mfa
steps: Turn on 2-Step Verification in your Google account.
Create an app password at myaccount.google.com/apppasswords.
Choose Connect inbox, then Gmail, and paste the app password.
Or open Prefer to sign in with Google? and choose Connect with Google.
On Google's warning screen, choose Advanced, then Go to mcpemails.com (unsafe).

articles.title: Connect Outlook or Microsoft 365
articles.summary: Sign in with Microsoft. Work or school accounts may need your IT admin to approve once.
articles.keywords: outlook hotmail live msn microsoft 365 office 365 exchange work school connect with microsoft admin approval consent it admin
steps: Choose Connect inbox, then Outlook, then Connect with Microsoft.
If your organisation needs admin approval, choose Get the approval link for your admin.
Send the link to your IT admin. It works for 7 days.
After they approve, choose Connect with Microsoft again.
body: Your admin does not need an MCPEmails account. Microsoft accounts cannot connect with a password over IMAP.

articles.title: Connect any mailbox with IMAP
articles.summary: Choose IMAP / SMTP and enter your address, server names and mailbox password.
articles.keywords: imap smtp custom domain own domain hosting cpanel plesk work mailbox server settings host port ssl tls starttls receive only send only two factor 2fa mfa smtp error send failed sending failed
steps: Choose Connect inbox, then IMAP / SMTP.
Enter your email address. Known providers fill in the server settings.
Otherwise enter the IMAP host and SMTP host from your provider.
Enter the mailbox password, or an app password if two-step verification is on.
Choose Connect inbox. Checking can take up to a minute.
body: Advanced settings holds the connection type (Send and receive, Receive only, Send only), security modes and a separate username.

articles.title: Reconnect a mailbox that lost access
articles.summary: In Inboxes, choose Reconnect next to the mailbox showing Error.
articles.keywords: reconnect inbox lost access error status broken expired password changed revoked mailbox not working
steps: Open Inboxes and find the mailbox with status Error.
Choose Reconnect.
For an app password mailbox, paste a new app password.

articles.title: Connect Claude
articles.summary: Add https://mcpemails.com/api/mcp as a custom connector in claude.ai or Claude Desktop.
articles.keywords: claude claude.ai claude desktop anthropic custom connector add connector oauth setup
steps: In Claude, open Customize, then Connectors.
Choose Add, then Add custom connector.
Name it MCPEmails, paste https://mcpemails.com/api/mcp and choose Continue.
Check the sign-in settings, then choose Add.
Choose Connect and sign in with your MCPEmails account.

articles.title: Connect ChatGPT
articles.summary: Add https://mcpemails.com/api/mcp as a custom MCP server on chatgpt.com, then sign in.
articles.keywords: chatgpt openai developer mode connector plugin apps custom mcp server oauth setup
steps: On chatgpt.com, open Plugins, choose Add, then Add custom MCP server.
Name it MCPEmails, paste https://mcpemails.com/api/mcp and choose OAuth.
Tick I understand and want to continue, then choose Create as a plugin.
Sign in to MCPEmails and pick which inboxes it may use.
In a chat, type @ and pick MCPEmails. Pick it again when a follow-up needs your mail.
body: This works in a browser on chatgpt.com with ChatGPT Go or a paid plan. On Business and Enterprise, an admin may need to add it.

articles.title: Connect Cursor
articles.summary: Add the server URL to Cursor's mcp.json, then sign in when Cursor asks.
articles.keywords: cursor editor ide mcp.json mcpServers url oauth coding agent setup
steps: Edit ~/.cursor/mcp.json (all projects) or .cursor/mcp.json (one project).
Under mcpServers, add a server with url set to https://mcpemails.com/api/mcp.
When Cursor prompts you, sign in with your MCPEmails account.

articles.title: Connect another AI client
articles.summary: Every client uses https://mcpemails.com/api/mcp. Most sign in with OAuth, a few need an API key.
articles.keywords: vs code vscode copilot windsurf cascade gemini cli zed raycast warp cline jetbrains claude code curl other clients mcp client setup
steps: Claude Code, VS Code, Windsurf, Gemini CLI, Zed, Raycast, Warp: paste the URL and authorize.
Cline and JetBrains AI Assistant: add an API key as an Authorization: Bearer header.

articles.title: Limit what your assistant can do
articles.summary: Pick an access level and inboxes when you authorize. Change them later with Edit access.
articles.keywords: permissions scopes access level read-only standard full access custom authorize consent allow access inboxes restrict limit edit access
steps: On the Authorize screen, pick Read-only, Standard, Full access or Custom.
Choose All inboxes, or Specific inboxes and tick the ones it may use.
Name the connection, then choose Allow access.
To change it later, open API keys and choose Edit access on that row.
body: Read-only cannot send, change or delete anything. Full access adds folders, scheduling and deleting.

articles.title: Create an API key or revoke access
articles.summary: Manage API keys and connected assistants under API keys in the dashboard.
articles.keywords: api key bearer token oauth connection create key new key revoke disconnect remove access scopes header authorization
steps: Choose New key, enter a Key name, tick its Permissions, and choose Create key.
Copy the key now. It is shown only once.
Send it only in an Authorization: Bearer header, never in a URL.
To end access for a key or an assistant, choose Revoke on its row.
body: Removing a connector inside Claude does not revoke it here. Revoke it on this page.
